text: Core courses Chinese Ancient History, Chinese Modern History, Chinses Contemporary History, History of the People’s Republic of China, World Ancient History, World Medieval History, World Modern History, World Contemporary History, World Current History, Selected Works on History, Historical Geography, Archaeology, Introduction to Historiography, Chinese Economic History, Pedagogy, Psychology, History Teaching Methodology in Middle Schools Objective This objective is to train students to meet the demand of teaching development in middle schools, so that students, after graduation, are able to work as history teachers in senior and junior secondary schools or do research work related to history teaching or serve as staff in schools. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted
